verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench is a free online toolset (Document Driver, Capital and Liquidation Calculators), and such a tool could plausibly embed an AI assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions any built-in AI assistant or way to delegate tasks to one. The documented tools are form-based document generators and calculators, and the probes found no llms.txt or API surface.
